messages:
oncall-bot: Pager triggered — canary group 'fastpath-v2' has sustained 5xx > 2% for last 5m. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/fastpath-v2 (chart: 5xx_rate). runbook: /runbooks/canary-failures.
Anya: I'm oncall — looking. which deploy version?
Mike: rollout id 2026-03-15T12:17Z, image tag fastpath:v2-rc3. I can see spikes from a subset of nodes (nodepool-gpu-9a).
Jess: quick heads up: early telemetry shows healthcheck failures from the canary target group, not the main traffic. possible config drift?
Raj: pulling logs now, but getting a lot of backend 502s in the request path:
```
2026-03-15T12:16:02Z ERROR request_id=abc123 upstream_status=502 upstream_host=kv-store-7 latency_ms=237
2026-03-15T12:16:03Z ERROR request_id=abc124 upstream_status=502 upstream_host=kv-store-9 latency_ms=241
2026-03-15T12:16:04Z WARN  healthcheck failure url=/healthz code=503
```
Anya: thanks — that looks like an upstream dependency flapping only for canary nodes. we need triage but also avoid impact on customers. any quick mitigation?
Mike: we have two levers: 1) abort the canary rollout (stop traffic to fastpath-v2), 2) flip the rollout feature flag to back off. abort is fastest.
Jess: agreed — abort the canary and hold. I'll open a revert PR for the image.
Anya: doing abort now. running: `rbctl abort --scope canary --name fastpath-v2 --reason "5xx spike" --who Anya`
Anya: output: `ok: canary fastpath-v2 traffic routing halted; draining in-progress requests`
Karen: flipping feature flag as belt-and-suspenders: `/ff toggle rollout.fastpath_v2 off --actor Karen --note "canary 5xx spike"`
Karen: ff system: `success: rollout.fastpath_v2=false`
SRE-Bot: Automation: created incident incident/2026-03-15-fastpath-canary, severity=SEV2, notified #incident-management. Pager status: acknowledged by Anya.
cust-impact-bot: Customer signals: 0 new public error reports. however, synthetic latency increased for ~120 accounts hitting fastpath endpoints. link: https://signals.internal/customers/fastpath-latency
Raj: after abort, canary 5xx dropped from 2.4% -> 0.2% within one minute. monitoring graphs: https://dash.internal/redwood/fastpath-v2?range=5m
Mike: confirmed — backend errors seem correlated with a specific KV node backend. isolating that infra.
Jess: handing off oncall — Anya to Mike for next 2h while I coordinate rollback PR and customer comms.
Anya: handing over pager to Mike — logs and notes pinned in thread. key actions done: abort canary, toggle ff off, open incident.
Mike: acknowledged takeover :phone: I'll keep an eye and coordinate SRE to investigate the backend kv-store. if 5xx reappears, we'll open the kill-switch and trigger global rollback.
Anya: thanks — leaving in Mike's hands. bookmarked runbook steps and tips: check nodepool-gpu-9a and kv-store-7/9 for connection errors, look for recent kernel updates.
Jess: creating postmortem ticket and initial timeline in incident repo. will attach telemetry and the FF toggle time.
SRE-Bot: Reminder: escalate to SEV1 if customer-facing errors > 0.5% or more than 10% of requests error within 15m. current metrics below thresholds.
Mike: monitoring: 5xx at 0.15% last 3m, latency normalizing. I'll do a gradual reroute only after infra fix and validation. handing back to oncall rotation later.
Anya: closing this thread for now — incident mitigated and rollout paused. leaving notes for postmortem and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
